back_content.text: 结论：短暂压力使大鼠新脑细胞增长翻倍，并提升后续记忆测试表现；研究者推测人类也可能类似。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Researchers discovered that placing rats in a stressful situation for just a few hours doubled the growth of new brain cells. The rats also did better on a memory test later on. Scientists think the same thing happens in humans.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Researchers discovered 标出研究发现；for just a few hours 限定压力时长；doubled the growth 和 did better on a memory test 是两个结果。② 核心规律：研究结论题要同时保留研究对象、实验条件和发现，不能只记“stress is good”。③ 验证与迁移：最后一句 Scientists think... 是从动物实验向人类迁移的推测，不是已被证明的人体结论。
tips: 研究结论要按“对象 + 条件 + 发现 + 推测边界”整理。
think / suggest / may 这类词表示推测，不等于确定结论。

back_content.text: 结论：homework 与 achievement 有一定相关性，但存在 upper limit；建议高中生每晚作业不超过 two hours。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The researchers concluded that there was an upper limit to the correlation between homework and achievement, suggesting that high school students should not be doing more than two hours of homework a night.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：suggested some correlation 表示有限相关；found the same was true 是复现证据；researchers concluded 引出最终结论。② 核心规律：研究结论题常考“不是越多越好”的边界，upper limit 是答案核心。③ 验证与迁移：two hours 是建议上限，不是平均作业时长；affluent communities 是研究样本范围，不应扩展成所有学生。
tips: upper limit 表示边界结论，通常比前面的相关性背景更重要。
suggesting 后面常接研究结论转化出的具体建议。
